description: This notice is for a BPA Call Order to be issued against an ex­isting Land Managementlntegrated Resources (LMIR) BlanketPurchase Agreement (BPA). To respond to this solici­tation, contractors must have an existing LMIR BPA that in­cludes Heritage Survey Services for the Medicine Bow-Routt National Forests and Thunder Basin National Grassland. Please see the attached BPA Call Order Form, Price Quote-Schedule of Items, submittal instructions, statement of work, map, and experience questionnaire. Please send any questions to andrea.haines@usda.gov no later than 5/12/2026, 3:00 MT.
